setup:
  codecov_url: https://{{.Values.codecov.host }}
  codecov_api_url: https://{{.Values.codecov.host }}

  debug: no
  loglvl: INFO

  guest_access: off
  admins:
    - service: gitlab_enterprise
      username: Saphir
    - service: gitlab_enterprise
      username: Alexsaphir

  http:
    cookies_domain: {{.Values.codecov.host }}

  timeseries:
    enabled: false
  ta_timeseries:
    enabled: false

  telemetry:
    enabled: false

gitlab_enterprise:
  enabled: true
  url: https://gitlab.${DOMAIN_NAME}
  global_upload_token_enabled: false

  bot:
    username: Codecov

services:
  redis_url: redis://dragonfly.database.svc.cluster.local:6379/4
  minio:
    host: minio.minio-system.svc.cluster.local
    bucket: codecov
    region: us-east-1
    verify_ssl: false
    port: 9000

notifications:
  slack: off
  gitter: off
  webhook: off
  irc: off
  hipchat: off

# Skip chown on mounted volumes, only run on /app
echo "Starting Mydia (skipping chown on mounted volumes)..."
mkdir -p /config /data /media 2>/dev/null || true
chown -R 1000:1000 /app 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -n "$TZ" ] && [ -f "/usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ" ]; then
  ln -sf "/usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ" /etc/localtime
fi
exec /app/bin/mydia start

cd /app
pip install --no-cache-dir --target /tmp/packages -r requirements.txt
export PYTHONPATH="/tmp/packages:$PYTHONPATH"
python app.py

/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-labs-charts-immich-mic.doc:
Immich is a self-hosted photo and video backup solution.

For immich, there are multiple helm deployments:

  • immich-web
  • immich-server
  • immich-typesense
  • immich-machine-learning
  • immich-microservices (this one)

For redis and postgres, there are multiple helm charts:

  • Redis: app-template/redis, bitnami/redis
  • PostgreSQL: operator cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg, bitnami bitnami/postgresql
